✨ New Features & Compatibility
Full Custom Dimension Support:

Completely eliminated hardcoded dimension restrictions. The mod now fully supports all third-party custom dimensions from other mods.

Overcame MCreator's native dimension selector limitation (which only supports Overworld, Nether, and End) by implementing automatic parsing and sanitization of cross-dimensional ResourceLocation namespaces.

releases.notes:
## 🚀 Death Back v0.1-Alpha Release

First public pre-release build for Minecraft **1.21.1 (NeoForge)**! 

> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT WARNING**: 
> This is an early **v0.1-Alpha** build for testing purposes. Bugs or unexpected behavior may occur. **Please make sure to back up your save files before using this mod in your world!**

---

### 🌟 Features Included

* **Death Point Tracking**: Automatically records precise coordinates and dimension data upon death.
* **Teleport Command**: Easy-to-use `/back` command to return to your last death location.
* **Cross-Dimensional Travel**: Supports returning to death points across different dimensions (Overworld, Nether, End).

---

### 🐛 Feedback & Issue Reporting

Since this is an Alpha release, your feedback is super helpful! If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or weird behavior, please feel free to open an **Issue** on this GitHub repository.
